bsh

Class BshLambda

  • java.lang.Object
    • bsh.BshLambda
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class BshLambda
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
    The runtime value of a lambda expression. Opaque until coerced to a functional interface, either by a cast or assignment (convertTo(java.lang.Class<T>)) or by overload resolution matching its arity marker (castLambda(java.lang.Class<?>, java.lang.Class<?>, java.lang.Object, boolean)).

    Public only because generated wrapper classes, defined in other class loaders, must call invoke(java.lang.Object[], java.lang.Class<T>, java.lang.Class<?>[]); it is not a supported API. Script errors and undeclared checked exceptions reach Java callers of a wrapper as RuntimeEvalError; unchecked exceptions and declared checked exceptions reach them as themselves.
